source.stem:
Multiple choice questions.

System of equations

$$
\left\{ \begin{array}{l} 3 x + 4 y = 5, \\ - 7 x + 9 y = - \frac {5}{2} \end{array} \right.
$$

The solution is ( ).

(A) $\left\{ \begin{array}{l}x = 2,\\ y = -0.25 \end{array} \right.$

(B) $\left\{ \begin{array}{l}x = -5.5,\\ y = 4 \end{array} \right.$

(C) $\left\{ \begin{array}{l}x = 1,\\ y = 0.5 \end{array} \right.$

(D) $\left\{ \begin{array}{l}x = -1,\\ y = -0.5 \end{array} \right.$

intelligence.enrichment: A spreadsheet cell is named by its column letter and row number, and a range written Start:End describes adjacent cells. Formulas such as SUM(range) and AVERAGE(range) compute totals and averages over the referenced row or column.
